theory_findings.finding: Overstates proof; must verify the failure cause is the missing behavior, not setup or unrelated failure.
theory_findings.correction: Describe as evidence the test detects this case, not proof of comprehensive behavior.

theory_findings.quote: «Зелёные тесты — страховка: если рефакторинг что-то сломал, они тут же покраснеют»
theory_findings.finding: False guarantee; tests can only detect regressions their assertions/execution cover. Contradicts edge_cases section.
theory_findings.correction: Tests provide feedback on covered claims and may expose regressions; they do not guarantee detection.

theory_findings.finding: Guarantee too strong; TDD can encourage testable design but cannot ensure it.
